description: This file defines the AppDelegate class for a Flutter macOS application, handling application lifecycle events such as termination behavior and secure state support.

classes.name: AppDelegate
classes.description: Subclass of FlutterAppDelegate managing application lifecycle events for the macOS Flutter app.

methods.name: applicationShouldTerminateAfterLastWindowClosed
methods.description: Returns true to indicate the application should terminate after closing its last window.

methods.name: applicationSupportsSecureRestorableState
methods.description: Indicates whether the app supports secure state restoration.
